responses.draft_cover_letter:
I’m excited about the Product Engineer role at Kindling because my recent work aligns directly with the stack you’re building. I designed and built REST APIs in Python using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy, created React‑TypeScript dashboards for warehouse operators, and owned a PostgreSQL data model where I partitioned the invoices table. All services run on AWS ECS managed through Terraform.

Delivering features end‑to‑end has been a core part of my responsibilities. I set up comprehensive pytest suites, contract tests, and GitHub Actions pipelines that accelerated our release cadence from weekly to daily deployments. This systematic approach ensures reliable, repeatable delivery of new functionality.

As lead engineer on an invoicing platform serving 40,000 small businesses, I have deep experience with billing‑related product logic and data structures. While my résumé does not list formal customer‑facing work, I am eager to collaborate directly with users and stakeholders to translate their needs into robust product solutions.

I look forward to contributing my Python, React, Postgres, and AWS expertise to Kindling’s invoicing platform and growing alongside the team.
